reviews.review: I've played Warframe for a couple years now. Watching it grow has been incredible. Warframe is an incredible game, though it's common for people to burn themselves out on it. I suggest that if you play it and reach that point, take a bit of a break from it, & come back to it when something new gets released. This game is ever evolving, & it's free! This game is even better than any game I've actually had to buy to play. The game developers are also really responsive to their player base. They always do their best to accomodate their customers. They are super friendly & always provide us with juicy teasers & also join in on our fun & jokes (Clem!). Warframe also has both closed missions & 4-player missions. They also have added free roam modes. Though I don't recommend playing the pvp mode or 'Conclave' as it's called. It's not very pleasant, as of this review. It's even more fun to play with friends, but can be enjoyed even if you don't have those, though it can be easy to make them.
Beautiful,free and really playable do you need more?:D

Considering gameplay, I don't know if this game is good or bad, really. First you need to register. When the alias is not available you need to re-type the email and password (twice). There is no hint if the alias is available. After 15 minutes, when you finally chose something valid (use random characters, Luke), you will see a small window with on-engine animation in it. I closed it and relaunched game, as I remembered there was a small settings-like icon in an upper-right corner. I used it and checked "full screen". Unfortunatelly, this causes game to run in the same funny resolution (but, of course, in a full screen), my tv gave up so I needed to relaunch game again. I patiently waited until the animation is finished, then some gameplay started (oh, there was also a class to chose). After few minutes I decided to switch the game to full screen, so I opened the options. What we got there... "razer chroma"... no... "connect with Steam account"... why not?... That was a trap. I waited like 5+ minutes then decided to close the window. Relaunched game. Same small window. Animation from beggining. Esc doesn't work. Nothing works. Man with ugly face and big hips shows that he's a pure evil for a 4th time. Did I mention I waited for like 10 minutes for a confirmation mail so I can play after registration? That was an intense hour. Enough.
You have been playing for over an hour. Please don’t forget to take a break.

I stopped playing Warframe because of the graphical mess it is. You can't see absolutely nothing except particle effect explosions and everything is a flashing messy nonsence moving extremely fast. Absolutely hated it. Even though the game was really fun and nice, the particle effects ruined the whole experience. I can't overstate how ♥♥♥♥♥♥ the particle effects later in the game become. It felt like having buckets of paint thrown into my face - nonstop.
